questions.definition: A **relic** is an object that has historical significance and is often kept as a reminder of the past.
options: an item made from ancient materials
a valuable piece of furniture from the 19th century
questions.answer: an item made from ancient materials

questions.definition: To **scrutinise** something means to examine it very carefully, often to find mistakes or flaws.
A **quaint** building has a charming, old-fashioned appearance that often suggests it is from a bygone era.
options: a dilapidated structure with no repairs

questions.definition: If someone is **exasperated**, they are very annoyed, often to the point of being almost frustrated.
questions.answer: extremely annoyed, often to the point of being almost frustrated

questions.definition: A **suburb** is a residential area that is typically on the outskirts of a town or city, often more affordable than the central area.
options: a small village within a park
a community outside the main city limits
questions.answer: a community outside the main city limits
